children: Twenty-year JGBs edge higher in price terms in the early Tokyo session after the Japanese Finance Ministry's 20-year auction on Tuesday saw record demand. There's a possibility that positive market sentiment stemming from strong results of yesterday's 20-year JGB auction will carry over, Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities' fixed income strategists say in commentary. The domestic bond market may also be supported by BOJ's scheduled purchases today of three sectors of JGB market, including sovereign securities with tenors of more than 25 years. The 20-year JGB yield is down 1 bp at 3.690%. No. 383 10-year JGB yield is unchanged at 2.905%. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
